provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: The comment 'Twin percentage' (L26) uses different terminology than 'Coherent_Percentage'; the relationship between twin/coherent naming is not explained.
audit_member_text: Copy/rename inconsistency at L24-L26: the variable and preceding comment describe coherent wave components, but the bound comment calls it 'Twin percentage'; no Twin variable exists.

base_member_text: save inputs.mat (L35) saves the function's local workspace; consumers (Coherence_Spectrum.m) load it wholesale, creating an implicit interface — any variable rename here silently breaks them.
audit_member_text: Hidden-state interface at L1 and L35: the function returns no values and serializes its whole local workspace to a fixed current-directory inputs.mat. Consumers must load implicit variable names, and an existing file is overwritten without a target path/version/schema check.

base_member_text: The clamp branch (L27-L31) is dead code for the hardcoded Coherent_Percentage=100; it only matters if a user edits the value.
mtheta=25, fmax, fmin, phase_include are defined but not used inside this file; their consumption is in sibling scripts not visible here.

audit_member_text: Cross-file feasibility risk: Coherent_Percentage=100 and mcomponent=mfreq=1125 at L3-L4/L24 feed the gate-read Coherence_Spectrum selection loop, whose pool excludes host frequencies. Reaching all 1125 coherent entries requires every host to acquire a guest before the guest pool empties; this configuration does not validate that against host count/placement.

The clamp at L27-L31 validates only Coherent_Percentage. mfreq/mtheta/mcomponent positivity and integrality, fmin<fp<fmax, depth/g positivity, sigma_theta nonzero, and phase_include domain are not checked before persistence.

mcomponent is set equal only to mfreq at L4 while a separate mtheta=25 is defined at L5; whether wave components should include the direction dimension is not explained, yet downstream coherent count uses mcomponent.
